title: list_agent_calls result
description: What list_agent_calls hands back to the model (docs/agent-tools.md, section 2): the calls tracked in the current scope, in the order they were started.

label.description: the label prompt_agent was given, when it was given one

address.description: the address the call went to

started_at.description: when prompt_agent started the call, UTC

ended_at.description: when the call finished, UTC; absent while it is open

open_calls.description: how many calls in the current scope are still open (running or input_required); absent when none is

open_calls_note.description: the same, in words, with what happens to them
